About The Album
Eusexua (/juːˈsɛk.ʃuː.ə/ yew-SEK-shoo-ə, stylised in all caps) is the third studio album by English singer FKA Twigs, released on 24 January 2025 through Young and Atlantic Records. It marks her first studio album in five years, following Magdalene (2019), and her first full body of work in over three years, following the mixtape Caprisongs (2022).
